translations.web: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.
translations.bsb: But those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone, so that the others will stand in fear of sin.
translations.kjv: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
translations.asv: Them that sin reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.
